color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
SC-001 happy path, must
Given A freight operations manager is on section 5 of their first PRD. Sections 1 and 4 are drafted and graded. They have 40 minutes before a meeting.

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: When They say they are ready to do the journeys section.

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: They read eight lines on what a user journey is, why requirements written one at a time miss the steps between them, and what a stage must name

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: They are asked to pick one person and one thing that person is trying to finish

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: They say "a dispatcher getting a late load recovered"

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: They are asked for the big steps, names only, and give five

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: They are asked, per stage, who acts, what they see and what they decide

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: They see a drafted journey with five stages, and a grade of 78 with no blocking defects

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: They are asked one question - what the dispatcher decides at stage three - and answer it

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p: They see the journey re-graded at 88

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: Then The journeys section is at status draft with a score of 88 and no blocking defects, one journey is marked as the golden thread, and every stage names an actor and a decision.
